IGUI_HUB_Intro: Open the windows of the HARMONIE mods from here. A window that needs something first says what to do.
IGUI_HUB_NeedVehicle: No vehicle next to you: the tabs about a vehicle are locked until you stand next to one (or sit in it).
IGUI_HUB_NeedGun: No gun in your hand: the gun tabs are locked until you hold one (or right-click a gun > Upgrade gun).
IGUI_HUB_GTP_Desc: Cooking recipes, vitamins, planting calendar and guide.
IGUI_HUB_TWA_Desc: Weapon crafting, materials, modifications and gem sockets.
IGUI_HUB_HM_Desc: Your own health: wounds, diagnosis, surgery and handbook. To examine someone else, right-click that player.
IGUI_HUB_SVU_Desc: Upgrades and part wear of the vehicle you are in or next to.
IGUI_HUB_MFS_Desc: Inspect and modify the gun in your hand.
IGUI_HUB_DebugGTP: Garden to Plate: vitamin admin panel
IGUI_HUB_DebugTWA: The Way To Attack: weapon in hand
IGUI_HUB_NotAdmin: Only admins or -debug can change these.
IGUI_MIL_NoInspect: The 3D inspect view could not be built (see console.txt).
IGUI_MIL_StatsNote: Green: the parts make it better. Red: the parts make it worse. For aim time, reload, recoil delay, noise and weight a smaller number is better.
IGUI_MIL_PartsNote: Install opens the part picker with every part that fits this slot, from your bags and the containers around you. Remove takes the part off (it goes to your inventory). You can also do both in the 3D inspect tab.
IGUI_MIL_AmmoNote: In the 3D inspect tab: click the loose rounds to pack them into a box, click the box to open it, click the magazine to choose another magazine that takes the same ammunition.
IGUI_MIL_Guide_Open: Right-click a gun > Upgrade gun (it is taken in hand and this window opens), or hold a gun and right-click > Inspect weapon, or press the Open Weapon Console key (Options > Keys), or open the HARMONIE tab of the character window (without a gun only the guide is open). The window closes when the gun leaves your hand or when you shoot.
IGUI_MIL_Guide_View: Drag with the mouse to turn the gun, use the mouse wheel to zoom. Hold Alt while dragging to turn it around another axis. Numpad 4, 5 and 6 turn it step by step.
IGUI_MIL_Guide_Parts: Every slot around the gun is a button. Click an empty slot to pick a part that fits (from your bags and the containers next to you). Double-click a part to remove it. The Parts tab lists the same slots.
IGUI_MIL_Guide_Position_T: Moving a part on the gun
IGUI_MIL_Guide_Position: The wrench button opens sliders next to the window: move each installed part forward, back, up or down. The gun remembers the position.
IGUI_MIL_Guide_Ammo: Below the gun: the loose rounds (click to pack into a box) and the boxes (click to open). The magazine button changes the magazine to another one of the same ammunition. The Ammo tab shows what you carry.
IGUI_MIL_Guide_Repair: The repair kit button (left of the ammunition) uses one Universal Weapon Repair Kit from your inventory and brings the gun back to full condition.
IGUI_MIL_Guide_Modes: Keys in Options > Keys > Mercenary Is Life: switch fire mode, toggle the light / laser mode, fire the device under the barrel, switch the grenade launcher mode, switch the tactical stance. Guns with more than one fire mode also have a fire-mode button in the 3D tab.
IGUI_MIL_Guide_Adapt: Vanilla scopes, red dots, lasers, gun lights, ammo straps, recoil pads and chokes can be adapted into the parts of this mod with crafting recipes (and turned back the same way).
IGUI_MIL_Guide_Tabs: 3D inspect: the gun and everything on it. Stats: every number, with and without parts. Parts: every slot. Ammo: what is loaded and what you carry. Guide: this page.
IGUI_MIL_Unpin: Unpin: the window folds up when the mouse leaves it
IGUI_MIL_Tab_inspect_Tip: The gun in 3D with every part slot, the stat bars, ammunition and the repair kit
IGUI_MIL_Tab_stats_Tip: Every number of the gun, with and without its parts
IGUI_MIL_Tab_parts_Tip: Every part slot: what is on it, what fits from your bags and the containers around you
IGUI_MIL_Tab_ammo_Tip: What is loaded and what ammunition and magazines you carry
IGUI_MIL_Tab_guide_Tip: How everything in this window works
IGUI_MIL_LockedTip: Hold a gun in your main hand to use this tab (or right-click a gun > Upgrade gun).
IGUI_MIL_NoGun: The 3D inspect, stats, parts and ammo tabs need a gun in your main hand. Take one in hand (or right-click a gun > Upgrade gun) and this window opens on it.
